mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_workers(worker_id, started_at, heartbeat_at) VALUES (#{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (worker_id) DO UPDATE SET heartbeat_at = now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_workers WHERE worker_id = #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('queued', 'retry_wait') AND available_at <= now() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < now()) AND lane = #{lane, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE tasks AS t SET status = 'running', attempt = t.attempt + 1, lease_owner = #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lease_until = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), heartbeat_at = now(), started_at = COALESCE(t.started_at, now()), progress_current = 0, progress_total = 0, progress_message = '', updated_at = now() FROM candidate WHERE t.id = candidate.id RETURNING t.id::text AS id, t.user_id::text AS user_id, t.kind AS type, t.lane, t.status, t.payload::text AS payload_json, t.attempt AS attempts, t.max_attempts, t.cancel_requested, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.lease_until) AS lease_until;
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET lease_until = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), heartbeat_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND lease_owner = #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('running', 'cancelling') AND lease_until > now()

UPDATE tasks SET progress_current = #{current}, progress_total = #{total}, progress_message = #{message, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lease_until = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), heartbeat_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND lease_owner = #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('running', 'cancelling') AND lease_until > now()

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'succeeded', result = CAST(#{result, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb), error = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, progress_current = CASE WHEN progress_total > 0 THEN progress_total ELSE progress_current END, progress_message = '已完成', finished_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND lease_owner = #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('running', 'cancelling')

UPDATE tasks SET status = CASE WHEN cancel_requested THEN 'cancelled' WHEN attempt < max_attempts THEN 'retry_wait' ELSE 'failed' END, error = CASE WHEN cancel_requested THEN NULL ELSE #{error, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END, available_at = CASE WHEN cancel_requested OR attempt >= max_attempts THEN now() ELSE now() + interval '30 seconds' END, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, finished_at = CASE WHEN cancel_requested OR attempt >= max_attempts THEN now() ELSE NULL END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND lease_owner = #{workerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('running', 'cancelling')

UPDATE tasks SET status = CASE WHEN cancel_requested THEN 'cancelled' WHEN attempt >= max_attempts THEN 'failed' ELSE 'retry_wait' END, error = CASE WHEN cancel_requested THEN NULL ELSE error END, available_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, finished_at = CASE WHEN cancel_requested OR attempt >= max_attempts THEN now() ELSE finished_at END, updated_at = now() WHERE status IN ('running', 'cancelling') AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_events(task_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{payload, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb))
